situation: Going to Lisbon Oct 10 to 17 and need someone to feed my cat. Want to ask my neighbour Tom, we chat in the hallway but aren't close.
reply: Hi Tom, it's Hana from 3B. I'm away 10 to 17 October and wondered if you could feed Miso once a day while I'm gone. It's about ten minutes: food, water and a quick scoop of the litter tray. I'd drop the key and a short list round on the 9th. If that week's no good, no problem at all, I'll book a sitter. I'll bring you back some pastéis de nata either way.
note: With someone you're not close to, naming the exact size of the job is what makes a yes easy.

situation: I want my old boss Greg to intro me to Aisha, who's hiring a data lead at Fernway. Haven't talked to Greg in about 6 months.
reply: Hi Greg, I'm applying for the data lead role at Fernway, and I saw you're connected with Aisha Rahman, who's hiring for it. Would you be comfortable sending her a short intro? I've written three lines you could forward as is or edit, so it should take five minutes. If you don't know her well enough to vouch, just say so and I'll apply the usual way. Thanks either way, and I hope the new team is treating you well.
note: Doing the drafting for them shrinks the cost; the out covers the real reason people hesitate on intros.

situation: Preciso pedir pro meu amigo Rafa, que tem carro grande, pra me ajudar a levar um sofá de Pinheiros até a Mooca no sábado.
reply: Rafa, pedido sincero: você toparia me ajudar a levar um sofá de Pinheiros até a Mooca no sábado de manhã? Umas duas horas contando o trânsito, e precisa do seu carro porque o sofá não cabe em carro pequeno. Se não der, de boa, eu chamo um frete. O almoço é por minha conta de qualquer jeito.
note: O custo, duas horas e o carro dele, vem logo de cara, para ele não topar algo maior do que imaginava.

situation: 我在申请荷兰代尔夫特理工的硕士，想请本科毕业论文的指导老师王老师写推荐信。毕业三年了，平时联系不多，截止日期是12月1号。
reply: 王老师您好，我是2023届的林悦，毕业论文是您指导的，做的是城市绿地和热岛效应。我现在在申请代尔夫特理工的城市规划硕士，需要一封推荐信，您是最了解我研究能力的老师，所以第一个想到您。大概需要您花一个小时，截止日期是12月1日，您同意的话，我这周就把简历、个人陈述和论文摘要整理好发给您。如果这段时间实在排不开，完全理解，麻烦告诉我一声，我好另外安排。无论如何都谢谢您！
note: 大一点的请求要说清为什么找他、要花多少时间、截止日期，并给一个真正的退路。

situation: I start a new job on Monday but my first paycheck doesn't arrive until October 30, and rent ($1,650) is due Thursday. I want to ask my older sister Mei to lend me $2,000. I've never borrowed from her before.
reply: Hi Mei, bit of an awkward ask, so I'll just say it. My new job starts Monday but the first paycheck doesn't land until 30 October, and rent is due on Thursday. Could you lend me $2,000 to cover rent and groceries until then? I'd pay it all back on 31 October and set up the transfer that day so you never have to chase me. Totally fine to say no if it's a stretch right now.
note: Money from family: exact amount, exact repayment date, and an out that doesn't need a reason.

situation: 上周五在微信上问同事小陈，10月8号周四我出差，能不能帮我代开一下客户周会，他一直没回。周会前我还得交接材料。
reply: 小陈，上周问你10月8号周四帮我代开客户周会的事，你那边不方便的话完全没关系，麻烦周五前跟我说一声就行，我好去问问其他人。能帮的话，我周五下班前把议程和客户背景发你，大概半小时就能看完。
note: 没回复时跟进一次，重申退路，给一个明确的回复时间；如果还是没回，就当作不行，换人问。

situation: My friend Marcus said he'd help me move tomorrow morning with his truck. He just texted that he can't make it, his daughter Ellie has a fever. I'm stressed and a bit annoyed but I don't want to guilt-trip him.
reply: Oh no, hope Ellie's fever breaks soon. No problem at all, I'll book a van for the morning. Give her a hug from me.
note: When a yes turns into a late no, absorb it in one line. No guilt trip keeps the door open for the next favour, in either direction.

situation: I have a job interview in Chicago on Wednesday Oct 14 and hotels are $250 a night. My college friend Amara lives there, we haven't seen each other in a year. Want to ask if I can crash on her couch Tuesday and Wednesday nights.
reply: Hi Amara! I've got an interview in Chicago on Wednesday 14 October, and I wondered if I could crash on your couch the Tuesday and Wednesday nights, 13 and 14. I'd be out most of Wednesday and heading to the airport Thursday morning, so I'd barely be in your way. Totally fine if it's a bad week, I'll book a hotel, no problem. Either way, dinner's on me Wednesday night, I'd love to catch up.
note: Name the exact nights and how little space you'll take, give a real out, and offer something you'd genuinely want to do anyway.

situation: My friend Dana is a commercial property lawyer. I'm about to sign a 3-year lease for my bakery and want her to look it over before Friday Oct 9. I don't want to take advantage of her just because we're friends.
reply: Hi Dana, you're the only lawyer I know who does commercial leases, so I'm going to ask: would you have 30 minutes before Friday Oct 9 to skim the 4-page lease for the bakery and flag anything that would worry you? Not a full review, just 'I'd push back on this clause'. If you'd rather keep work and friends separate, or you'd want to bill it as a normal job, say so, both are completely fine. Dinner at Osteria Nove is on me either way.
note: When the favour is someone's profession, keep the scope narrow and make paying or declining as easy as saying yes.

situation: 我在火锅店做服务员，10月10号周六是我的晚班，那天我表妹订婚，想去。想问同事小敏能不能跟我换班，她下周二10月13号是早班，我可以替她上。
reply: 小敏，想请你帮个忙：10月10号周六的晚班你能跟我换吗？那天我表妹订婚。你13号周二的早班我来上，你那天能睡个懒觉。周六晚上人多挺累的，不方便就直说，我再问问别人。周四前告诉我就行。
note: 换班请求把日期、代价（周六晚班累）和回报一次说清，再给一个真的出口和答复期限。

situation: I'm on night shifts at the hospital from Oct 12 to Oct 30, so I can't do the 5pm Tuesday and Thursday run to football practice for my son Eli (9). Want to ask the other parents in the team WhatsApp group if anyone can take him.
reply: Hi all, a practical ask: I'm on night shifts from 12 to 30 October, so I can't do the 5pm run to Tuesday and Thursday practice for Eli. Could anyone with a spare seat pick him up from the Ashgrove Primary gate at 4:45 on one of those days? It's six sessions in total, so even one or two would help a lot. No worries if the timing doesn't work, I'll book the after-school club otherwise. Once I'm back on days I'm happy to take a carful on Saturdays.
note: In a group ask, split the favour into small pieces so people can offer one slot without signing up for all six.

situation: I manage a team of six. We need two people to help staff our stand at a home show on Saturday Oct 17, 9am to 3pm. It's not in anyone's contract and I want it to be genuinely optional, not the kind of 'volunteer' everyone knows is mandatory.
reply: Hi team, a genuinely optional ask: I need two people to help me run our stand at the Leeds Home Show on Saturday 17 October, 9am to 3pm. It's mostly chatting to visitors and handing out brochures, on your feet most of the day, with travel paid. Anyone who does it gets a full day off in lieu, on a date of their choosing. If nobody fancies it, that's completely fine, it won't come up at review time and I'll book temp staff instead. Message me privately by Friday 9 October if you're up for it.
note: When you have power over the person, the out has to be explicit, and private replies mean nobody feels watched saying no.

situation: I'm an ICU nurse thinking about moving into UX research. I found Jordan Lee on LinkedIn, a UX researcher at a health-tech company who used to be a nurse too. We've never met. I want to ask for a short call.
reply: Hi Jordan, I'm an ICU nurse in Leeds looking at a move into UX research, and your path from nursing into research at Carewell is the closest match to mine I've found. Would you be open to a 20-minute video call sometime in the next few weeks? I have three specific questions, mostly about how you landed your first research role, and I'll fit around your schedule. If you're too busy, no problem at all, and thanks for reading this either way.
note: A stranger owes you nothing: say why them, cap the time, and make ignoring the message painless.

situation: 上个月表哥刚帮我搬了家。现在我妈10月14号周三下午3点到南京南站，我那天在合肥出差赶不回来，想再请表哥去接一下，送到我家，来回大概一个半小时。
reply: 哥，上个月刚麻烦你帮我搬家，这次又要开口：我妈10月14号周三下午3点到南京南站，我那天在合肥出差赶不回来，想请你去接一下，送到我家，来回大概一个半小时。那天要是上班走不开，完全没关系，直接跟我说，我给她叫个专车就行。等我回来，请你和嫂子吃饭。
note: 连着第二次找同一个人帮忙，提一句上次的情分，把退路说得具体，让他拒绝也不为难。

situation: I'm a freelance web designer. The site I built for Rosa's restaurant, Casa Verde, went live a month ago and she was really happy. I want to ask if I can feature it in my portfolio with a short quote from her.
reply: Hi Rosa, now that the Casa Verde site has been live a month, I'd love to feature it in my portfolio. Could I show it with the restaurant's name, and would you answer three short questions by email for a quote? It's about ten minutes, and I'd show you the finished page before it goes up. If you'd rather keep the project private, that's completely fine and changes nothing between us. If you say yes, the case study will link to your booking page too.
note: Asking a client: name the exact time it takes, let them approve the result, and make no a comfortable answer.

situation: I'm 23 and renting my first apartment. The letting agency wants a guarantor because I'm new in my job, and I want to ask my uncle Raj. The lease is $1,800 a month for 12 months.
reply: Hi Uncle Raj, I've found my first apartment and the agency needs a guarantor because I've only just started my job. I'd love it if that could be you, but I want to be upfront about what it means: as I read the lease, if I didn't pay, you'd be responsible for the rent, up to $21,600 over the 12 months, plus anything else the clause covers, like damage. I'll send you the guarantor clause so you can check exactly what you'd be signing. If it's not something you're comfortable with, that's completely fine, and I'll ask the agency about other options. Could you let me know by Friday 9 October?
note: When a favour carries financial risk, name the worst case in numbers and share the document; hiding the size of the ask is the one thing to avoid.

situation: I'm Sophie at number 14. We're having our bathroom redone from Oct 12 to Oct 16, and the builders need to put a skip outside our neighbour Mrs Dalton's front wall, which means she loses her usual parking spot for those five days. We've only said hello a few times, and she could use the space outside ours instead.
reply: Hi Mrs Dalton, it's Sophie from number 14. We're having our bathroom redone from Monday 12 to Friday 16 October, and the builders need to put the skip outside your front wall, which would take your usual parking spot for those five days. Would that be okay with you? You'd be very welcome to use the space outside ours while it's there. If it's a real nuisance, just say, and I'll ask the builders what else we can do.
note: Name the real cost (her parking, five days), offer what you can in return, and leave a genuine out.

situation: In March my friend Priya asked me to help paint her flat and I said no because of a work trip. Now my new laptop is being delivered on Tuesday Oct 6 between 9 and 1 and needs a signature, but I'll be at the office. She works from home two streets away, and I could redirect the delivery to her address and collect it that evening. It feels cheeky after I turned her down.
reply: Hi Priya, a small ask, and I know I still owe you for missing the painting in March. My new laptop arrives on Tuesday Oct 6, sometime between 9 and 1, and needs a signature while I'm at the office. Could I redirect it to yours and pick it up that evening? If Tuesday's awkward, just say so, no problem at all.
note: Having once said no, name it in half a line and keep the ask small; a long apology makes it heavier.

situation: 我一个人在深圳工作，10月13日周二上午要在市二医院做无痛胃镜，全麻，医院要求必须有成年人陪同，做完签字再接我回家，大概早上8点到11点。想请关系不错的同事小雅帮忙，她得为这个请半天假。
reply: 小雅，想请你帮个忙：我10月13日周二上午在市二医院做无痛胃镜，要全麻，医院要求必须有人陪着，做完签字再送我回家。时间大概是早上8点到11点，你得为这个请半天假，我知道不是小事。要是那天走不开，直接跟我说就好，我再问问别人。做完请你吃顿好的！
note: 时间、地点和请半天假这个代价一次说清，退路是真的；不需要解释为什么要做检查。

situation: Ma fille Inès a 3 ans et mon mari Julien et moi faisons notre testament chez la notaire le 20 octobre. On voudrait demander à ma meilleure amie Camille d'être la tutrice désignée d'Inès si jamais il nous arrivait quelque chose. On a une assurance vie qui couvrirait ses frais, et on sait que c'est énorme à demander.
reply: Camille, j'ai une grande demande, et je préfère te la faire franchement. Avec Julien, on fait notre testament chez la notaire le 20 octobre, et on aimerait te désigner comme tutrice d'Inès s'il nous arrivait quelque chose à tous les deux. Ça voudrait dire l'élever, et c'est énorme, même si notre assurance vie couvrirait ses frais. Prends le temps d'y réfléchir, et si c'est non, ça ne change rien entre nous, vraiment. Tu peux me dire d'ici le 15 octobre ?
note: Plus la demande est lourde, plus il faut nommer son vrai poids et laisser du temps pour répondre.

situation: My car's in the garage until Monday, and on Saturday October 3 I need to drive my mum to a hospital appointment an hour away at 10am. My friend Kate doesn't use her car at weekends. I'd need it from 8am to 2pm and would return it with a full tank, but I don't know if her insurance covers another driver.
reply: Hi Kate, a bigger ask than usual: could I borrow your car on Saturday 3 October, from about 8am to 2pm? Mine's in the garage and I need to drive Mum to a hospital appointment an hour away. I'd bring it back with a full tank. The one thing to check first is whether your insurance covers another driver. If it doesn't, or you'd just rather not lend it, that's completely fine and I'll hire a car.
note: When the favour puts their property at risk, name the risk and let them check before they say yes.

situation: I'm flying with my son Theo, who's 4, and the airline split our seats: I'm in 23C, an aisle, and he's in 25A by the window. The man in 25B is already seated. I want to ask him to swap with me so I can sit with Theo.
reply: Excuse me, could I ask you a favour? My son Theo, he's four, is in the window seat next to you, and I'm in 23C, an aisle seat two rows up. Would you be willing to swap so I can sit with him? If you'd rather stay put, that's completely fine and I'll ask the crew.
note: With a stranger, say exactly what seat he'd be swapping into, and make the out real: the crew is the backup, not him.

situation: I teach Year 4 and we're holding a careers morning on Thursday Oct 22. Mrs Okoro, the mum of one of my pupils, is a paramedic, and I'd love her to give a 20-minute talk with questions at 10am. She works shifts, and I don't want her to feel she has to say yes because I'm her son's teacher.
reply: Hi Mrs Okoro, we're holding a careers morning for Year 4 on Thursday 22 October, and I'd love to ask whether you'd come in and talk about being a paramedic. It would be about 20 minutes at 10am, including the children's questions. I know you work shifts, so if the day doesn't fit, or it's simply not your thing, that's completely fine and it won't change a thing. Thank you for considering it.
note: From a child's teacher, a parent may feel a no is risky, so the out has to say outright that nothing changes.

situation: 我10月12日到25日去德国出差。我爸78岁，一个人住，楼下的李阿姨跟他很熟，也有我的微信。想请她这两周每天下午敲门看一眼我爸，大概五分钟。
reply: 李阿姨，想请您帮个忙：我10月12日到25日去德国出差，我爸一个人在家。这两周您方便的话，每天下午敲门看他一眼，五分钟就够，看到他好好的给我发个微信说一声。万一敲门没人应，或者他看着不舒服，请直接打120，再跟我说。那段时间要是不方便，完全没关系，直接告诉我，我再想别的办法。回来请您喝茶！
note: 请邻居照看老人：每天做什么、花多久说清楚，紧急情况先打120写在明处，再给一个真的退路。

situation: 好朋友小雯在香港出差，10月20日（周二）回上海，出差期间住酒店。我想请她帮我带一套英文绘本回来，我在网上下单直接寄到她酒店，书钱我自己付。整套大概3公斤，挺占行李箱的。
reply: 雯雯，你20号从香港回来对吧？想请你帮个忙：帮我带一套英文绘本，我在网上下单直接寄到你酒店，钱我来付，你只要装进箱子就行。整套大概3公斤，挺占地方的，行李要是满了或者不方便，直接说不行就好，我再想别的办法。
note: 把重量和占地方说在前面，她才能真正自由地说不。

situation: 我10月10日到19日一个人去新疆徒步，山里大部分时候没有手机信号，我带了卫星通讯器。想请好朋友阿琳当我的紧急联系人：每天晚上9点前我给她发消息报平安；超过24小时没消息，就请她按我发给她的行程单打110报警，再联系我姐姐。
reply: 阿琳，想请你帮个比较重要的忙：我10月10日到19日一个人去新疆徒步，想请你当我的紧急联系人。具体是这样：每天晚上9点前，我用卫星通讯器给你发一条报平安；如果超过24小时没收到消息，请你按我发你的行程单打110报警，然后联系我姐姐。这十天你都得留意手机，是个不小的负担。你要是觉得压力大，或者那几天不方便，直接说就好，我再找别人。回来给你带新疆的葡萄干！
note: 当紧急联系人是一份责任：触发条件和要打的电话写清楚，报警这一步明确写出来，她就不用临场判断。
